title: Fast construction of five-term geometric progressions for NFS
exact_target: Efficiently find short five-term modular geometric progressions that avoid low-order rational recurrences and yield small coprime cubic polynomials for the number field sieve.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 8800033 (AMR-087-0033). CC BY 4.0.

Peter L. Montgomery, \emph{Searching for Higher-Degree Polynomials for the General Number Field Sieve}, IPAM Number Theory and Cryptography: Open Problems workshop (9--13 October 2006), slides headed ``Five-term GP → Two Cubics and ``Desire a five-term GP mod N.
